stocks.label: Ledger
stocks.subject: Ledger: everything leaves as softly as it comes. Back or × on Add, the account picker, All, every bottom sheet, the Stocks forms and sheets: a copy of what was showing fades and drops away while the real one is hidden at once (the hidden property wrapped on each overlay, mGhost; copies at the end of the page, inert, no ids), so no closing code changed and a quick tap lands underneath. A picker going a page deeper slides in from the right, back from the left (mSwap). Redraws of Add and of an open sheet: a part that was not there rises in, a pick newly on pops (Transfer's To row, Bank/Card/Cash, chips). Number keys nudge the amount, the back key shrinks it. The Stocks forms rise in like Add. ledger-motion-e2e covers each (5 more mutants red); the other Ledger e2e suites pass as before, and the ones on the real sheet fail the same way on master. Asked: "When I click backspace from here or z also add a small animation. In fact can u add subtle ones throughout the entire app please".
